title: Common providers: Singapore
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the mobile network operators, the main fibre broadband providers and the wholesale fibre network; business ISPs are partial.
missing: Smaller business ISPs and data-centre providers
An AS number for NetLink Trust (wholesale only: it sells no internet service)
Status pages (none was found that answered a check)
A website for NetLink Trust (it answered an automated request only with a refusal or a bot check on the read date)

sources.name: IMDA (Infocomm Media Development Authority): list of telecommunication licensees
sources.terms: The page links to terms of use that could not be read by an automated check; no reuse licence was found, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Singapore and Telecommunications in Singapore
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 10 names were found on the pages.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 10 websites and 2 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty. An address that answered only with a refusal, a bot check or a page-not-found page counts as one that did not answer.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 18 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: Singtel
providers.notes: AS7473 is the backbone, AS9506 and AS3758 fixed broadband, AS45143 mobile. The support address is the business page.

providers.name: StarHub
providers.notes: The support address is the business page.

providers.name: MyRepublic
providers.notes: The name is also used in Indonesia by another company (MyRepublic Indonesia in that pack).

providers.name: NetLink Trust
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre network: seldom the name on the bill.
